title: GSM3119483
organism_ch1: decidua sample from recurrent spontaneous abortion patients
extract_protocol_ch1.1: RNA was extracted by RNeasy Kits (Qiagen, Hilden, NRW, Germany) and treated with DNase I (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Wilmington, DE, USA) according to standard protocols. RNA-sequencing was done in Genesky using TruSeq Stranded mRNA Library Preparation (Genesky, Shanghai, China). Briefly, intact RNA was fragmented, end repaired, adapter ligation and PCR amplified following illumina protocol. Libraries were sequencing by illumins Hiseq 2000.
taxid_ch1: RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using standard Illumina protocols
data_processing.1: Illumina Casava1.7 software used for basecalling.
data_processing.2: Sequenced reads were trimmed for adaptor sequence, and masked for low-complexity or low-quality sequence, then mapped to hg19  whole genome using tophat with default parameters
data_processing.3: Fragments Per Kilobase Of Exon Per Million Fragments Mapped (FPKM) were calculated using a protocol from Cole Trapnell  et al., Nature Protocols volume 7, pages 562–578 (2012).
platform_id: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: tab-delimited text files include FPKM values for each Sample ...

contact_city: NO.818 Tianyuan East Road, Jiangning District
